ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across both lobes, with a localized cluster of high-intensity (white) pixels on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black/grey) region covering ~90% of the visible surface. A high-contrast, irregular white mottled patch is located on the right lobe distal quadrant, extending from the trailing edge inward. Sparse white speckling exists along the right trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible U-shaped depression at the center-line with a depth of approximately 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central trailing edges. Significantly higher amplitude, irregular protuberances are clustered at the lateral distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to a slight convexity before tapering into hooked terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast brown and white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of barnacle growth and associated scarring on both lateral fluke tips; slight irregular indentation on the right lobe distal edge within the white pigment patch.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray/droplets creating high-intensity noise and occlusion along the lower visible boundary of the fluke and trailing edge.
